proves: The current public headers compile against the maintained LibreCAD_3 DXFimpl override surface checked by lc3_compat_check.
A downstream target requesting C++14 receives a usable compile contract through the public dxfrw target.
doesNotProve: A clean LibreCAD or LibreCAD_3 checkout and full application build.
Runtime DXF/DWG import, export, or changed-LTYPE-definition save/readback behavior.
ABI binary compatibility, native platform qualification, or DWG feature parity.
